submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole peaks on the word that continues an already-introduced discourse referent with an elaborating or characterizing continuation: an anaphoric pronoun, possessive, or definite subject plus a copular, relational, or eventive predicate (It is, He is, they were, Por su, es, relates), a coordinated evaluative modifier (great and gratifying, noble and so), or an expressive nominal (a grin). Strength accumulates from a matching antecedent many tokens back plus an evaluative or formulaic continuation, and collapses when the subject has no antecedent or the continuation is a neutral concrete description.
